scope: Motif Help menu and dialog interaction; automated native menu/level/topic/read-only selection flow in the current Theme Lab build.

diagnosis.previous_failure: The test translated a Motif widget position without the actual X window origin and attempted input before the window manager finished mapping the shell. In Xephyr the cascade click landed at y=22, on the titlebar; popup items queried before mapping were relative to their popup shell.
diagnosis.manual_reproduction: On the owned Xephyr :83, clicking Ajuda opened the pulldown, selecting Geometria, escala e fonte opened the dialog, the level list showed all three choices, and Expert replaced the text with the corresponding explanation.

details: For widgets with their own X window, translate click coordinates with XTranslateCoordinates from that window to the screen root; preserve XtTranslateCoords for Motif gadgets, which share their parent's window.
Wait 700 ms for the main shell to finish window-manager mapping/reparenting, post the cascade, wait 250 ms for the popup shell to map, then calculate and click the selected menu item.

flow: Open cascade and select a topic
Choose Expert and Novice levels and verify distinct text
Choose another topic and return to Intermediate
Select and copy the read-only help text; verify clipboard contents
Confirm cut/paste do not mutate read-only text
Close, reopen from another topic, close by WM protocol, reopen and verify the project field is unchanged

uncompleted_attempt.result: Not counted: xvfb-run repeatedly started new Xvfb display numbers without launching the child test. The run was interrupted; the same test binary passed directly on the owned Xephyr with Openbox.

limitations: The Xvfb wrapper itself did not complete; the native test was run and passed in Xephyr with Openbox.
